listening.title: Ghi biên bản cuộc họp phòng ban

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Minh, can you take the minutes for today's meeting?

lines.speaker: Minh (Note-taker)
lines.text: Sure. Should I write everything verbatim or just summarize?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Just summarize, but keep the client's exact request in shorthand.

lines.speaker: Minh (Note-taker)
lines.text: Got it. I'll also add a timestamp next to each decision.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Good idea. That will help us keep track of the timeline later.

lines.speaker: Minh (Note-taker)
lines.text: Should I use the usual template for the action items?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Yes, please. And make sure each item has a clear action owner.

lines.speaker: Minh (Note-taker)
lines.text: I'll highlight the deadline for each task too.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Team Lead)
lines.text: Perfect. Once it's done, archive it in the shared drive.
